name: Netorare Kareshi
source:
Yukito and Reika are dating. One day, Reika's mother, Sayuri, overhears their conversation. Something Reika says hurts Sayuri's pride so much that she decides to steal her boyfriend...

[Translated from [url=http://willtame.jp/n_k/index.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
幸人与丽华正在交往。一天，丽华的母亲小百合无意中听见两人的谈话。丽华说的一句话严重伤害了小百合的自尊，于是她决定把女儿的男朋友抢过来…

[Translated from [url=http://willtame.jp/n_k/index.htm]official website[/url]]
